about_short_description.short_description: Defer is a zero-infrastructure Node.js background jobs platform to offload APIs.

product.name: Background Functions
product.description: Allows developers to offload long-running tasks as background jobs, which are executed asynchronously.

product.name: Builds & Executions
product.description: Automatically packages and runs background functions in isolated environments, ensuring efficient execution.

product.name: Scheduler
product.description: Enables scheduling of background jobs to run at specific times or intervals, with support for retries and concurrency management.

product.name: Runner
product.description: Executes background functions in a dedicated environment, with support for native dependencies and local imports.

product.name: Local Development & Testing
product.description: Provides tools and guidelines for testing background functions locally before deployment.
